records.referent_role: 常山王 (Prince of Changshan), a prince/royal figure

records.explanation: 兄弟 in the annotation '兄弟二人不能相容' refers to the two brothers (淮南厲王長 and 文帝) from the 漢書 story about the folk song. It is a collective kinship reference to the two brothers mentioned in the preceding annotation.
records.referent_role: brothers (collective)

records.explanation: 甄德 is a full name reference to Zhen De, a distinct person from 王濟. They are mentioned together as two separate people who both sent their wives to petition.
records.referent_role: 甄德, a Jin official who also sent his wife to petition

records.explanation: The mention 婦 in annotation-002 refers to wives sent by 甄德 and 王濟. The text '而甄德王濟連遣婦入来' indicates both men sent their wives. This is a compositional kinship reference where 婦 means wife. It corefers with the earlier 婦 mention in annotation-001 (sfh1-mention-9d3555dd93bf90cf957640aa) which also refers to wives sent in.
records.referent_role: wife (of 甄德 and 王濟 respectively)

records.explanation: 陛下 is a ruler reference addressing the emperor (武帝). It corefers with 武帝, 帝, and the pronoun 我 used by the emperor earlier in the text. It is distinct from 臣 (the speaker, 王武子) and from 王武子 and 和嶠.
records.referent_role: addressee

records.explanation: 齊王 is the ruler title for the prince who is the emperor's brother. The emperor says '今出齊王' (now sending 齊王 out), referring to sending this prince to a fief. This 齊王 corefers with the earlier 齊王 mention in annotation-001 (sfh1-mention-4388280325a2cfed95b82750).
records.referent_role: 齊王, a prince (the emperor's brother) being discussed for removal from the capital

records.explanation: The pronoun 之 in the annotation text '一尺布尚可縫一斗粟尚可舂而共食况以天下之' refers to the cloth/rice metaphor from the folk song about brothers, not a specific person. It is an anaphoric reference to the preceding content about the cloth and grain.
records.referent_role: referent of the folk song about brothers

records.explanation: 朕 is the emperor (武帝) speaking, referring to himself. He says '我兄弟至親' (my brothers are closest kin), referring to 齊王 as his brother. He addresses 王戎.
records.referent_role: emperor

records.explanation: 嶠 is the abbreviated personal name referring back to 和嶠, the same person. He responds to the emperor.
records.referent_role: official/advisor

records.explanation: 齊王 is a ruler title for the Prince of Qi. The 常山王 and 長廣公主 enter to plead for him (陳乞留之). This 齊王 corefers with the later 齊王 mention in annotation-002 (sfh1-mention-27ca11c3f8524afefcb5372e).
records.referent_role: 齊王 (Prince of Qi), the person being pleaded for

records.explanation: The mention 祖 in '祖甚恚謂王戎曰' refers to the emperor (武帝) himself, who is the ancestor figure speaking. The text '祖甚恚' describes the emperor being very angry. The emperor (我, sfh1-mention-45cfe474b180d425df945d0b) says '我兄弟至親' referring to his own brothers. The 祖 here is the speaker, the emperor, who is the ancestor of the ruling house. This is a compositional kinship reference where 祖 refers to the emperor as ancestor.
records.referent_role: ancestor (the emperor's ancestor, i.e., 武帝's ancestor)

records.explanation: 我 is the first-person pronoun used by 祖 (the emperor) in his speech to 王戎. It refers to the emperor himself, who says '我兄弟至親' (my brothers are closest kin), referring to his relationship with 齊王.
records.referent_role: first-person pronoun referring to the speaker (祖/emperor)

records.explanation: 長廣公主 is a ruler title for the Princess of Changguang. She is the wife of 常山王 (referred to as 婦 in the text), and she enters together with him to plead for 齊王. She is distinct from 常山王 and 齊王.
records.referent_role: 長廣公主 (Princess of Changguang), wife of 常山王

records.explanation: 王戎 is the full name of the person addressed by 祖 (the emperor) in the annotation. He is the recipient of the emperor's speech about 齊王.
records.referent_role: addressee of 祖's speech; 王戎 is the person being addressed by the emperor (祖)

records.explanation: 帝 is a shortened anaphoric reference to 武帝, the same emperor. He continues speaking to 和嶠.

assertions.exact_span: 武帝語和嶠曰我欲先痛罵王武子然後爵之
assertions.interpretation: Emperor Wu tells He Jiao his plan to first berate Wang Wuzi and then ennoble him — this is the immediate scene.
assertions.surface: 武帝語和嶠曰我欲先痛罵王武子然後爵之

assertions.interpretation: The emperor then summons and harshly reproaches Wang Wuzi, following his stated plan in sequence.

assertions.exact_span: 它人能令踈親臣不能使親踈以此愧陛下
assertions.interpretation: Wang Wuzi concludes his reply, saying others can make the distant close but he cannot make the close distant, hence his shame before the emperor.
assertions.surface: 它人能令踈親臣不能使親踈以此愧陛下

assertions.exact_span: 遣常山王與婦長廣公主共入稽顙陳乞留之
assertions.interpretation: Background: Changshan Wang and his wife Princess Changguang had earlier prostrated and begged to keep Qi Wang from leaving — context preceding the scene.
assertions.surface: 遣常山王與婦長廣公主共入稽顙陳乞留之

assertions.exact_span: 齊王當出藩而王濟陳請無數又累
assertions.interpretation: Background from Jin Zhugong Zan: Qi Wang was about to be sent to a fief while Wang Ji repeatedly petitioned against it — prior events leading to the emperor's anger.
assertions.surface: 齊王當出藩而王濟陳請無數又累

assertions.exact_span: 祖甚恚謂王戎曰我兄弟至親今出齊王自朕家計
assertions.interpretation: Background: The emperor (Zu) was greatly angered and told Wang Rong that sending Qi Wang out was a family matter — prior to the scene.
assertions.surface: 祖甚恚謂王戎曰我兄弟至親今出齊王自朕家計

assertions.exact_span: 而甄德王濟連遣婦入来生哭人邪
assertions.interpretation: Background: Zhen De and Wang Ji repeatedly sent their wives in to weep — prior events provoking the emperor's anger.
assertions.surface: 而甄德王濟連遣婦入来生哭人邪

assertions.interpretation: Background: The emperor remarks that if Wang Ji and others act this way, what of the rest — part of the prior angry exchange.
Later outcome: From this point onward Wang Ji was reproached — a consequence following the scene.
Later outcome: Wang Ji was demoted to Guozijian Jijiu (Director of the National University) — a subsequent consequence.

assertion.exact_span: 武子曰尺布斗粟之謠常爲陛下耻之
assertion.interpretation: Wang Wuzi responds during the reproach, citing the 'chi bu dou su' ballad as something he is ashamed of on the emperor's behalf.
assertion.surface: 武子曰尺布斗粟之謠常爲陛下耻之

assertion.exact_span: 漢書曰淮南厲王長高祖少子也有罪文帝徙之於蜀不食而死民作歌曰一尺布尚可縫
assertion.interpretation: Quoted precedent from Hanshu: Prince Li of Huainan, a younger son of Gaozu, was exiled by Emperor Wen and died fasting; the people made a song about the chi bu — the historical source of the ballad Wang Wuzi cites.
assertion.surface: 漢書曰淮南厲王長高祖少子也有罪文帝徙之於蜀不食而死民作歌曰一尺布尚可縫
